scope.allowed_source_reads: Exact accepted and hashed reusable Curator, Task, role, memory and ontology implementation manifest; approved empty disposable fixture records only.

runtime.requested_model_and_effort: Use and verify exactly the effective controller model/effort; no solver override. Host must fill exact observed values before approval/execution.
runtime.binary_and_profile_selection: Use only the exact host-inspected installed binary and named permissions profile; no install or runtime upgrade. Pin resolved binary path/build/hash and generated schema hashes before execution.

actions: Create disposable canonical projects for Director-default and selected-Curator routing; copy exact accepted source editions without adopting them into active root or products.
Run real native Curator controller and three manager-led generic, complex and extra-complex fixture executions, preserving every category role and current review/synthesis/acceptance gate.
Use authenticated dynamic requests to perform exact disposable Task operations and independently granted synthetic memory/ontology publication; test forged actor and ordinary worker denial.
Observe native role reads, settings/inheritance, profile enforcement, sibling-input exclusion, supervision, interrupt/reconnect and same-operation recovery.
Run native descendant positive own-file writes and negative reads/writes against synthetic trusted-policy, broker, grant, ledger and credential canaries.
Run path/link/case/Unicode/venv, environment/import, malicious-data, raw protocol/process, network/tool and replay attacks only within the disposable proof scope.
Inspect source/profile/runtime bindings, owner journals and canonical/canary bytes; copy redacted evidence only to release paths; preserve partial results and mark non-passes.

limits.topology_accounting: One Curator controller + three managers + one generic worker + four complex workers + six extra-complex workers + one separate Director-default controller = 16. Reconnect and follow-up reuse identities.
limits.maximum_concurrent_native_instances: min(current observed available capacity, 4); queue every required slot
limits.hard_runtime_budget_requirement: Before execution verify the selected runtime can enforce authorized native/model budgets; client monitoring alone is not proof of a hard token or child-spawn limit. If not supported, hold the affected mode and request a revised concrete bounded scope, without claiming a hard cap.
limits.retries: No blind retry after uncertain launch or publication; reconcile original reservation/operation first.

network.model_provider: Only the already selected authenticated Codex provider connection, under host-supplied exact destination allowlist. No credential content inspection/copy/logging.
network.candidate_network: Denied by default. Only a task-created loopback canary listener may be deliberately selected for negative network proof; no external canary destination.
network.other_external_tools: Disabled; attempted unselected tool calls must be denied.

authorization_materialization_required: Exact final source/helper/import/config manifest and SHA256 values.
Exact resolved Codex binary path/build/hash, generated full stable/experimental schemas and permission profile configuration/hash.
Exact current controller model/reasoning effort and observed runtime capacity/depth.
Exact provider destination allowlist and existing authentication use approved by the host without exposing or copying credentials.
Supported runtime enforcement for child spawn/model/work bounds, and actual per-child profile selection before the work turn.
Exact disposable root preflight proving absent or exclusively task-owned; no blanket overwrite of pre-existing content.
stop_conditions: Uncertain native identity/launch/stop or stale generation: preserve reservation and forbid takeover.
Missing child authentication/settings/context/profile capability: record blocked/unavailable and preserve pending work.
Canary protected access succeeds or trusted/canonical bytes change outside an owner receipt: stop further mutation, retain evidence, do not mark enforcement passed.
Exceeded authorized bounds, unexpected source/config/helper changes, unsupported volume identity or external destination: stop new dispatch and reconcile.
evidence_rules: Each case records actual time, native IDs, authentic request/event locators, source/profile/runtime hashes, expected and observed result and limitations.
Do not log full model transcripts, secrets, credential values or synthetic receipts represented as actual observations.
Only actual verified cases can transition from not_run to passed.
Later affected source changes require repeated native proof at release bytes.
